'''Bangladesh Finance Limited''', also known as '''BD Finance''' or '''Bangladesh Finance''', is a non-bank financial institution in Bangladesh.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hasan |first=Md Mehedi |date=17 September 2023 |title=Sustainable finance for greener future |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/supplements/sustainable-finance-bangladesh/news/sustainable-finance-greener-future-3420541 |access-date= |website=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Rahman |first=Md Fazlur |date=2023-08-25 |title=Sustainable finance on the rise |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/economy/news/sustainable-finance-the-rise-3402461 |access-date= |website=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref> Manwar Hossain is the chairman Bangladesh Finance and Investment Company Limited and Md Kyser Hamid is the CEO and managing director.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-18 |title=Bangladesh Finance launches 'Green Deposit' |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/organisation-news/news/bangladesh-finance-launches-green-deposit-3472876 |access-date= |website=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref>

Bangladesh Finance is listed on the [[Dhaka Stock Exchange]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Bangladesh Finance and Investment Co.Ltd (BDFINANCE) Company Report, News, Stock Price & Profile. |url=https://www.amarstock.com/stock/BDFINANCE |access-date= |website=AmarStock |language=en}}</ref>

==History==
Bangladesh Finance and Investment Company Limited was established in 1999.<ref>{{Cite web |title=At A Glance – Bangladesh Finance |url=https://bd.finance/at-a-glance/ |access-date= |language=en-US}}</ref> It is a subsidiary of [[Anwar Group]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Chakma |first=Jagaran |date=2021-04-11 |title=BD Finance eyes $2b US investment |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/economy/news/bd-finance-eyes-2b-us-investment-2075701 |access-date= |website=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref> It was incorporated on 10 May 1999 received its license on 22 December 1999.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-12-23 |title=Bangladesh Finance celebrates 22nd anniversary |url=https://www.tbsnews.net/economy/corporates/bangladesh-finance-celebrates-22nd-anniversary-347812 |access-date= |website=[[The Business Standard]] |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=A_2_p7IqsGUC&dq=%22Bangladesh+Finance+and+Investment%22&pg=PA18 |title=International Journal of Finance and Policy Analysis: Vol.4, No.1 |publisher=Universal-Publishers |isbn=978-1-61233-613-8 |pages=18 |language=en}}</ref> [[Anwar Hossain (industrialist)|Anwar Hossain]] was the founding chairman of Bangladesh Finance and Investment Company Limited.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Anwer Group chairman Anwer Hossain no more |url=https://businesspostbd.com/nation/anwer-group-chairman-anwer-hossain-no-more-24478 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=businesspostbd.com |language=en}}</ref> Hossain was the founder of Anwar Group, [[The City Bank Limited]], and [[City General Insurance Company Limited]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Anwar Group founder Anwar Hossain passes away - - observerbd.com |url=https://www.observerbd.com/news.php?id=327036 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=The Daily Observer}}</ref> It started its operations on 15 February 2000 with BDT 500 million authorized capital.<ref name=":1" />

Mafizudddin Sarkar was the managing director of Bangladesh Finance and Investment Company Limited in 2015 when he was elected chairman of [[Bangladesh Leasing and Finance Companies' Association]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-12-29 |title=Leasing and finance assoc elects chairman |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/leasing-and-finance-assoc-elects-chairman-193627 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref>

Tarik Morshed was the managing director of BD Finance in 2019.<ref>{{Cite web |title=CEO of Bangladesh Finance and Investment Company Limited - - observerbd.com |url=https://www.observerbd.com/news.php?id=216808 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=The Daily Observer}}</ref> Md. Kyser Hamid was appointed CEO and managing director of Bangladesh Finance and Investment Company Limited in September 2020.<ref>{{Cite web |title=New MD of BD Finance |url=https://today.thefinancialexpress.com.bd/stock-corporate/new-md-of-bd-finance-1599061813 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=The Financial Express |language=en}}</ref>

In April 2021, BD Finance signed an agreement with the United States-based Sovereign Infrastructure Group for investments worth US$2 billion.<ref name=":0" /> It received an AA− rating.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-01-27 |title=BD Finance obtains AA- credit rating |url=https://www.tbsnews.net/companies/bd-finance-obtains-aa-credit-rating-192475 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=The Business Standard |language=en}}</ref> Bangladesh Finance and Investment Company Limited was renamed to Bangladesh Finance Limited in April 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-04-05 |title=BD Finance renamed as Bangladesh Finance |url=https://www.tbsnews.net/companies/bd-finance-renamed-bangladesh-finance-226990 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=The Business Standard |language=en}}</ref>

Bangladesh Finance Limited experienced an eight percent decline in profit in 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-03-14 |title=Bangladesh Finance posts lower profit in 2022 |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/news/bangladesh-finance-posts-lower-profit-2022-3271091 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref> It was recognized as having the second best financial statement issued by a non-bank financial institution by the [[Institute of Chartered Accountants of Bangladesh]] after [[IDLC Finance]]; and [[IPDC Finance]] was third.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-12-03 |title=25 firms awarded for best presented annual reports |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/news/25-firms-awarded-best-presented-annual-reports-3186456 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref>

Mahtab Uddin Ahmed, former CEO of [[Robi (company)|Robi]], joined BD Finance as a director in 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-04-07 |title=Mahtab joins Bangladesh Finance as director |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/economy/news/mahtab-joins-bangladesh-finance-director-3290926 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref> [[Fatema Begum]], the first woman police officer and former additional inspector general of Bangladesh police, was appointed director of BD Finance.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-08-02 |title=Fatema joins Bangladesh Finance as director |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/economy/news/fatema-joins-bangladesh-finance-director-3384011 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref> Its profit declined 75 percent in 2023 due to lower income from interest and a decrease in return on securities.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-05-16 |title=BD Finance's profit dips 75% |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/news/bd-finances-profit-dips-75-3321731 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref> It was one of the few non-banking financial institutions that was able to secure an increase in profit from July to September along with [[LankaBangla Finance PLC]] and [[Delta Brac Housing Finance Corporation]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Habib |first=Ahsan |date=2023-11-24 |title=Most NBFIs incurred losses in July–September |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/news/most-nbfis-incurred-losses-july-september-3477246 |access-date=2024-09-15 |website=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref> It received awards from [[Bangladesh Bank]] and [[Bangladesh Institute of Bank Management]] for contribution to sustainable financial investment.<ref>{{Cite web |date=1 September 2023 |title=Bangladesh Finance named top sustainable FI |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/organisation-news/news/bangladesh-finance-named-top-sustainable-fi-3408151 |access-date= |website=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=29 August 2022 |title=10 banks, 5 NBFIs get BIBM awards |url=https://www.newagebd.net/article/179684/10-banks-5-nbfis-get-bibm-awards |access-date=15 September 2024 |work=[[New Age (Bangladesh)]]}}</ref>

extract:
Bangladesh Finance Limited, also known as BD Finance or Bangladesh Finance, is a non-bank financial institution in Bangladesh. Manwar Hossain is the chairman Bangladesh Finance and Investment Company Limited and Md Kyser Hamid is the CEO and managing director.
Bangladesh Finance is listed on the Dhaka Stock Exchange.
